significance: The Divya Desam of Thirukkoyilur, where Vishnu stands as the Trivikrama who strode the three worlds; its granite structure took shape under Virarajendra Chola, and its 59-metre gopuram is the third tallest temple tower in Tamil Nadu.
story: Here Vamana the dwarf is said to have begged three paces of land from king Mahabali and grown to measure the universe.
